newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 11.

text.p: Sharp Corp plans to sell desk-top PCs with liquid crystal display screens for home-use starting next spring. Sharp hopes to include a drive to play digital video discs (DVDs) in the computer. The price will be around 300,000 yen.

Apple Computer Inc and Hewlett-Packard Co plan to jointly develop ink-jet printers. The two are considering selling ink-jet printers under the Apple brand name as early as 1997. Apple would end a reselling agreement it currently has with Canon Inc.
